nodes.name: DEFAULT
nodes.documentation: A static field built by a generated builder: bytecode runs it in the static initializer, the source engine's field holds it.

nodes.name: initialCount
nodes.documentation: An instance field initialized through a generated getter: bytecode runs it in every constructor.

nodes.name: pending
nodes.documentation: A field of a type only the processor declares: the source engine cannot resolve it.

nodes.name: accessorCalls
nodes.documentation: A getter, a setter, and a call chained after a getter: the chained call is unbound too in the source engine.

nodes.name: builderCalls
nodes.documentation: The builder chain: a static factory, a method per field, build(), and toBuilder() on the result.

nodes.name: callDescribeBuilder
nodes.documentation: A call to that method.

nodes.name: closureCalls
nodes.documentation: A generated getter as a method reference inside a stream pipeline: a site inside a closure.

nodes.name: comparedCalls
nodes.documentation: Generated equals, hashCode, toString with exclusions.

nodes.name: constructorCalls
nodes.documentation: The three generated constructors.

nodes.name: dataCalls
nodes.documentation: The constructor @Data generates, the accessors, equals, hashCode, toString.

nodes.name: delegateCalls
nodes.documentation: Delegated interface members called on the delegating class.

nodes.name: describeBuilder
nodes.documentation: A parameter of a type only the processor declares: the source engine's id for the method cannot name it.

nodes.name: fluentCalls
nodes.documentation: Fluent accessors chained through this returns.

nodes.name: multiLineChain
nodes.documentation: Calls chained after a generated getter, one per line: bytecode puts each on its own line, the source engine all on the first.

nodes.name: multiLineConstructorCall
nodes.documentation: A generated constructor called on a continued line: javac attributes the call to the statement's line, the diagnostic to its own.

nodes.name: plainCalls
nodes.documentation: A written member on a class without Lombok: bound by every engine.

nodes.name: primitiveClassOnAnUnboundLine
nodes.documentation: A primitive class literal on a line the source engine cannot bind: bytecode reads Integer.TYPE, a field only bytecode stubs.

nodes.name: valueCalls
nodes.documentation: The all-arguments constructor and a getter of a @Value class.

nodes.name: witherCalls
nodes.documentation: A wither returning a copy, chained.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.documentation: A written method beside the generated ones: declared in both engines.

nodes.name: lombok
nodes.documentation: Classes whose members Lombok generates, and the callers that use those members.

nodes.name: GeneratedMemberCallers
nodes.documentation: Calls to every generated member: unbound sites for the source engine, calls for the bytecode engine, and the hybrid engine's reason to exist.

nodes.name: GeneratedMembers
nodes.documentation: One nested class per Lombok feature; the member each one generates is what the source engine lacks.

nodes.name: Built
nodes.documentation: builder(), the nested Builder class with a method per field, build() and toBuilder().

nodes.name: Compared
nodes.documentation: Explicit equals, hashCode and toString with an excluded field.

nodes.name: Constructed
nodes.documentation: Three generated constructors.

nodes.name: DataHolder
nodes.documentation: Accessors, equals, hashCode, toString and the required-arguments constructor.

nodes.name: Delegating
nodes.documentation: Every method of List<String> delegated to the field: generated implementations of the interface's members, which javac alone cannot see the class implements.

nodes.name: FluentAccessors
nodes.documentation: Fluent, chaining accessors: name() reads, name(String) writes and returns this.

nodes.name: GetterSetter
nodes.documentation: getName(), getCount(), setName(String), setCount(int).

nodes.name: Plain
nodes.documentation: No Lombok at all: identical in every engine.

nodes.name: ValueHolder
nodes.documentation: An immutable class: private final fields, getters, the all-arguments constructor, equals, hashCode, toString.

nodes.name: Withers
nodes.documentation: withName(String) and withCount(int) returning a copy.

diagnostics.message: vision.noesis.fixture.lombok.GeneratedMembers.Delegating is not abstract and does not override abstract method subList(int,int) in java.util.List
